title: Register for a Rental Bonds Online account (agents)
summary: This page explains how property agents can register for a Rental Bonds Online account to manage residential rental bonds.
intro:
NSW Fair Trading’s Rental Bonds Online (RBO) service helps agents, landlords and tenants pay and refund residential rental bonds.

If you're a property agent, you must be registered with RBO. You must offer the service to new tenants as the first option for lodging their rental bond.
what_you_need: The 'Rental Bonds Online agency registration form – PDF'

how_to_steps.text: Complete the form and email it to the address on the form.

more_info.text: After NSW Fair Trading has processed your application, the principal user will be sent an email with instructions for activating your agency’s RBO account.
The principal user can update agency details, and add or remove agency users.

faqs.q: What is the Rental Bonds Online (RBO) service?
faqs.a: RBO helps agents, landlords, and tenants pay and refund residential rental bonds.

faqs.q: Do I need to register if I am a property agent?
faqs.a: Yes, if you are a property agent, you must be registered with RBO.

faqs.q: What is the first option for lodging a rental bond?
faqs.a: Property agents must offer the RBO service to new tenants as the first option for lodging their rental bond.
